name: @deckgauge/api
//ai-sdk-pin: ai and @ai-sdk/anthropic are pinned EXACTLY, not caret-ranged. `ai` 7.0.93 changes the tool-call loop enough to break AdvisorService.ask, AdvisorHelpService.ask and the advisor ask route's scoped-reader test — the loop resolves no text and no toolCalls, so the three suites fail with empty results rather than an error. Bisected: 7.0.48 passes all 31 cases, 7.0.93 fails 3 files. The previous range `^7.0.48` ALLOWED 7.0.93, which means main only worked because its lockfile happened to hold 7.0.48 — a fresh `pnpm install` resolving the range afresh would have broken the Advisor silently. The pin makes the working version explicit. Lifting it is a real migration against the new SDK behaviour, not a version bump.
